items.name: Spear
items.desc: A normal pike that Meatball commissioned to be made by a blacksmith years ago. Used in such a way with Meatball's ability it can be considered a major threat but only in his hands.

actions.name: Thrust
actions.notes: Thrust the pike into the target.

actions.name: Accelerated Thrust
actions.notes: Thrust the spear with an extended arm at a rapid pace causing the air pressure around the pike to act as a wider blade. At this speed the blade might not even hit the target and instead the wind will do the damage.
